text:
maria (Sales): FYI customer (UK finserv) POC is blocked. They pinned model `gptx-legacy-v2` and calls are returning an error: 

maria (Sales): example error in their logs: 
``` 
{"error":"model_not_available_in_region","model":"gptx-legacy-v2","region":"eu-west-1"}
``` 

maria (Sales): They also say some requests are getting 429s intermittently when retrying. Need triage and a customer-facing workaround.

tom (Solutions): can you paste the curl they used and the exact timestamp of a failing call? also which environment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

maria (Sales): hosted API, sample request they shared: 
``` 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-legacy-v2","input":"summarize...."}'
``` 

jia (Eng): thanks. quick note: `gptx-legacy-v2` was scheduled for region sunset in eu-west-1 last month (deprecation rollout). Some control-plane routes will 404/`model_not_available_in_region` if pinned. we didn't fully block GETs yet which explains intermittent 429 when retries hit fallback pools.

oliver (SRE): attaching the short SRE view from our edge logs (sanitized): 
``` 
[2026-03-21T10:12:01Z] upstream_error code=503 route=/generate pool=fallback-eu token=***
[2026-03-21T10:12:04Z] rate_limit code=429 route=/generate pool=dyn-eu token=***
[2026-03-21T10:12:04Z] client_error code=404 msg="model_not_available_in_region"
``` 

karen (Security): customer requires CMEK/HSM for keys. question: does the suggested fallback model variant support customer-managed keys?

jia (Eng): short answer: the fallback we can supply quickly is `gptx-quant-slim`, which is in eu-central and eu-west but it currently does NOT support BYOK/HSM (it uses host-managed keys for token encryption). migrator path exists but needs infra changes and lead time.

maria (Sales): they explicitly asked for BYOK in contract. this is a blocker for the close. any temporary options?

tom (Solutions): options: 1) spin a Dedicated trial (reserved pool) where we can provision a VPC with HSM access and pin a compatible model build, 2) propose a short-term feature exception but that requires security sign-off, 3) change pinned model to a supported hosted variant (but violates their BYOK need).

oliver (SRE): Dedicated route is feasible fast if we have capacity; provisioning timeline ~48-72h for a small trial pool (subject to GPU availability). fallback hosted with cross-region routing will still hit the key mismatch.

karen (Security): we can do an exception for POC if legal signs off and we put controls in place (data deletion, reduced retention). need a security questionnaire entry and an owner for the temporary risk acceptance.

maria (Sales): customer asked for cost estimate for a 2-week Dedicated trial with HSM. do we have ballpark?

tom (Solutions): ballpark: reserved trial node (1x A100-equivalent) + HSM connectivity setup and support -> ~ $12k-$18k for 2 weeks (includes infra add-ons). will confirm exact with finance.

jia (Eng): engineering note: if we go Dedicated, we should create a model build that matches their pinned sha (we can rebuild `gptx-legacy` weights into a quantized image that supports our HSM stack). rebuild time ~24h, QA another 24h.

maria (Sales): action items: 1) confirm Dedicated capacity availability, 2) security to draft temporary acceptance, 3) pricing to confirm, 4) engineering to estimate exact rebuild time.

oliver (SRE): I've opened infra ticket INF-8461 to check capacity and queue the Dedicated trial (link: https://internal/infra/INF-8461).

karen (Security): I'll start the temporary exception doc and fill the sec questionnaire sections. who should be owner? maria, can you be primary?

maria (Sales): yes I'll own customer comms.

tom (Solutions): I'll pull finance numbers and update. tagging @jia for rebuild ETA once capacity confirmed.

model-deploy-bot: Notice: model `gptx-legacy-v2` removed from eu-west-1 on 2026-03-15 as part of deprecation rollout. See internal:models/gptx-legacy/notes.

maria (Sales): thanks all. any non-Dedicated quick workaround we can tell the customer to unblock low-risk testing?

jia (Eng): quick workaround: switch POC to `gptx-compat-v1` hosted in eu-central (no BYOK) for non-sensitive tests, and run sensitive flows on Dedicated trial. makes contractor happy while reducing blocked work.

maria (Sales): I'll propose that plan to the customer. tagging this thread for updates — will post customer decision and we can track INF-8461. :thumbsup:

tom (Solutions): noted. I'll prep a short proposal and cost appendix.

oliver (SRE): if we get go for Dedicated, prioritize region eu-central for lower latency to their users.

karen (Security): once we have the Dedicated plan I'll need the detailed runbook for HSM keys and retention controls.

maria (Sales): thanks everyone, closing for now. will update with customer response in this thread.
